svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 07: Event basics
svg.text: Admin keeps only what the whole event shares. Each section saves on its own, because each belongs to a different part of the platform.
Use case: an organiser sets the event’s name, dates, time zone, venue, look and who gets in, choosing from lists instead of typing (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: What the whole event shares. Each part’s own settings are in that part.
On the hub, the screens and every page.
Times on every page and screen follow it.
Addresses and venue info come from the venue.
Who can read the info pages?
The run of show, announcements, venue info.
Members see the Wi-Fi password and their own pages.
At the venue or with the link

svg.text: A · 1280 px: two columns of sections; the time zone is a searchable list grouped by region, the likely zones first

g.text: On the hub, the screens and every page.
Times on every page and screen follow it.
Who can read the info pages?

svg.text: B · 390 px: the same sections, one column
C · dates are a range picker, times from a list
Notes: each section saves through its owner: dates and access the event’s, time and language admin’s (D4).
Access asks three questions in plain words instead of naming modes (L5). The venue is picked from the venues.
